title: Perfect complexes over a derived-complete ring are derived complete
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $I\subseteq A$ be an ideal, and let $D(A)$ be the derived category of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume that $A[0]$ is derived complete with respect to $I$ [def-weil-point-derived-complete-module-complex]. Then every perfect $P\in D(A)$ [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], meaning an object isomorphic to a bounded complex of finitely generated projective $A$-modules, is derived complete with respect to $I$.

source.place: Tag 091S, definition-derived-complete and the immediately following assertion that D_comp(A,I) is strictly full, saturated and triangulated; Tag 0ATI, lemma-perfect-ring-classical-generator

proof.text: Fix f in I. Exact countable products of modules (Mathlib ModuleCat.AB) give countable products in D(A) by lem-weil-derived-countable-products-existence. Complete the Roos endomorphism of the constant ring tower to a distinguished triangle using TR1. Completeness of A[0] and lem-weil-pbc-module-localization-tower-vanishing imply that every map from A[1/f][0][q] to A[0] is zero for every integer q.

Let S be the shift-and-isomorphism closure of the singleton A[1/f][0], and Q its right orthogonal. Mathlib CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Orthogonal shows Q contains zero and is closed under isomorphisms, shifts and distinguished extensions. Q is closed under retracts directly: if i:X -> Y and r:Y -> X satisfy i;r=id, a map g:Z -> X from an S object has g;i=0, hence g=(g;i);r=0. The vanishing from step 1 places A[0] in Q, including sources merely isomorphic to shifts by precomposing with the inverse isomorphism.

The universal property ObjectProperty.triangEnvelope_le_iff puts the triangulated envelope of A[0] inside Q. By lem-sf-perfect-ring-classical-generator this envelope is exactly IsPerfectRingComplex, so every perfect P lies in Q. In particular every map A[1/f][0][q] -> P vanishes. Apply lem-weil-pbc-module-localization-tower-vanishing to each derived limit T of the multiplication-by-f tower of P to obtain IsZero T. Quantify over f in I and all product structures and T as in def-weil-point-derived-complete-module-complex.
